units.source_zh: 既然攻取滨松城会损失惨重，而撤退无害，那就寻机撤退。

units.source_en: But there is no need for undue haste.”

paragraphs.source_zh: 胜赖心不在焉地听着，好生懊恼！他开始害怕那一股不断推动自己作出错误举动的隐形力量。“好。既然攻取滨松城会损失惨重，而撤退无害，那就寻机撤退。但不必过急。”

paragraphs.source_en: “A wise decision, my lord. Please give the order at once.”

units.source_en: “A wise decision, my lord.
Please give the order at once.”

paragraphs.source_zh: “少主英明。请马上下令吧。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Summon Ōi.”

units.source_en: “Summon Ōi.”

paragraphs.source_zh: “叫大炊来。”

paragraphs.source_en: Mino-no-kami hurried out of the tent, loudly calling for an attendant. In the gathering dusk, the sound of the autumn wind once more enveloped the earth.

units.source_en: Mino-no-kami hurried out of the tent, loudly calling for an attendant.
units.source_zh: 美浓守急急向帐外走去，大声叫着下人。

units.source_en: In the gathering dusk, the sound of the autumn wind once more enveloped the earth.
units.source_zh: 薄暮中，秋风声又笼罩了大地。
